pages.title: Cryptochrome Magnetoreceptor
pages.text: A protein from a robin's eye that senses Earth's magnetic field through a pair of entangled electron spins. Light makes the pair; the field tips their dance. The crystal turns slowly in the hand to point north.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Migratory birds see magnetic fields, probably via radical pairs in cryptochrome. I folded the protein from feather genetics, entangled its radical pair with a photon pair and grew it in nutrient broth. It aligned with the field.
Made in $(item)Gene Sequencer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Quantum Biology.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Psionic Crystal.
